checklist_items.reason: The remaining partial entries cover the original enum predicates only; the explicit table items have separate real metadata-volume and mutation proof. Form selection persistence and other states remain independent.
checklist_items.10.1: covered: The list's four states are driven through the real GET /api/v1/images. A 503 on that read surfaces the error Alert and its Retry control instead of an empty table; retrying once the route is back returns 200, clears the Alert and restores exactly the row set the independent GET reports. A held read leaves the table in its spinning state until the response is released, after which the fixture rows render. The 503 is then removed from the unexpected-failure log so it is accounted for rather than ignored. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.5: covered: The sole ImageSeriesTable authority starts at the original page-size20 before any size edit, with exact ten-row IDs. Its menu contains exactly10/20/50/100. Each real10/30/100 corpus is independently traversed at every actual size; reload retains selected100, and final restoration to20 survives another reload. The same table is not duplicated under the enable-cycle contract. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.6: covered: Actual Next/Previous clicks traverse every page forward and backward for each real10/30/100 corpus at10/20/50/100 per page. Every visible row name and stable ID matches the independent declared order, with no duplicates or omissions. Active page, exact translated total and first/last boundary disabling are checked on every page; numbered last-page controls are also used for the actual cross-page details. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.7: covered: On the real100-row table, page10 at size10 changes to page1 at size20 with the first20 exact IDs. From page5, the Enabled filter returns the first20 of50 independently declared enabled rows; resetting restores total100 and the first20 exact IDs on page1. On a separate21-row corpus, UI deletion of the sole page3 row returns204 and independently removes its series/version/detail; total20, active page2 and the final ten exact remaining IDs are checked. This page has no keyword-search control. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.8: covered: Three separately owned real metadata corpora of exactly10,30,100 series and one version each are imported through the real API and verified by independent complete list/detail GETs before UI paging. Each uses every actual page-size and complete forward/backward traversal; actual Details actions on pages1/3/10 open the declared last row with matching browser and independent GET IDs. A fourth21-row corpus exercises real last-page deletion. All161 created series/versions are scoped-cleaned with detail404 checks and the full original collection restored. This is catalogue metadata, without image pull, agent, container or inference claims. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.12: covered: With the real100-row corpus, forty native ArrowRight presses expand the series column from240 to880 and create table-internal horizontal overflow. Native wheel scrolling reaches both right and left extremes; the actual Details control remains fully inside the1440-wide viewport while document width stays within the viewport. Clicking that control opens the correct declared metadata row; forty ArrowLeft presses restore240. The assertion targets the real button and viewport geometry, rather than a fixed-column CSS class. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
checklist_items.10.3: covered: Every visible option of engine, framework and status is selected on its own and reset, with the expected rows derived from the owned authoritative rows rather than from a product query, so a shortcut that returns the full set would fail. Two conditions are combined in one filter and across two filters, a third is added, and engine/framework are then set to values that each match rows while their intersection is empty - the table goes empty there and recovers when one filter is removed, which is the case a naive AND of two non-empty sets would pass and a union would fail. The refresh proves the read carries no invented filter parameter: GET /api/v1/images returns the same independent collection and the local filters still hold. Runs: 20261105T114151Z-79d72578 (en) and 20261105T113814Z-f6b7bebc (zh), same source_sha c553a2a87561a244 and binary_sha256 d4dbe14cebfbf1ac, both PASS.
